bio.text: Mary Fortier represents Connecticut's 79th Assembly District in Bristol and Forestville.
A lifelong Bristol resident, she grew up in the Federal Hill neighborhood of Bristol, where she still lives.
She served eight years on the Bristol City Council.

She graduated from Boston College in 1983 with a B.A. in history and secondary education, earned a J.D. from Western New England College School of Law in 1995, and worked for most of her legal career as a clerk in the State of Connecticut Judicial Branch.
